hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$' || exit 0; if echo "$f" | grep -q '/web-app/'; then cd /home/user/lumo-task-web/web-app && npm test 2>&1 | tail -20; elif echo "$f" | grep -q '/backend/'; then cd /home/user/lumo-task-web/backend && npm test 2>&1 | tail -20; fi
